components.name: Primary Button with Arrow Square
components.description: Primary and conversion actions; the arrow square is the signature.
components.html: Fale no WhatsApp
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 48px; padding: 0 6px 0 20px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Host Grotesk Variable', 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; white-space: nowrap; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #0a6cff; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px -14px rgb(10 108 255 / 0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1a78ff; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -14px rgb(10 108 255 / 1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5aa2ff; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-box { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); } .ds-btn-box svg { transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn:hover .ds-btn-box svg { transform: translate(2px, -2px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgb(150 172 214 / 0.26); color: #f2f5fa; background: transparent; font-family: 'Host Grotesk Variable', 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 300ms, background-color 300ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgb(242 245 250 / 0.5); background: rgb(242 245 250 / 0.04); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5aa2ff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with label above, blue border and ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: 'Host Grotesk Variable', 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: #f2f5fa; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid rgb(150 172 214 / 0.26); background: #070b14; color: #f2f5fa; font: inherit; outline: none; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7f8ca4; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(242 245 250 / 0.4); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0a6cff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgb(10 108 255 / 0.2); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Body-color links with a blue underline drawn from the left on hover and current.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-family: 'Host Grotesk Variable', 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #a3aec2; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='true'] { color: #f2f5fa; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 1px; background: #0a6cff; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 400ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current='true']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5aa2ff; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Ruler with Lit Segment
components.description: Section frame: hairline baseline, 12px minor ticks, 96px major ticks, and a lit segment placed by page position.
components.css: .ds-ruler { position: relative; height: 12px; background: linear-gradient(rgb(150 172 214 / 0.42), rgb(150 172 214 / 0.42)) top left / 100% 1px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(150 172 214 / 0.2) 0 1px, transparent 1px 12px) top left / 100% 6px no-repeat, repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(150 172 214 / 0.42) 0 1px, transparent 1px 96px) top left / 100% 11px no-repeat; } .ds-ruler-lit { position: absolute; top: -1px; height: 3px; width: 9%; min-width: 48px; background: #0a6cff; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 2px rgb(10 108 255 / 0.55); }

components.name: Measure Label
components.description: Mono uppercase tabular measurement (duration) and the recommended badge.
components.css: .ds-measure-row { display: flex; gap: 16px; align-items: center; } .ds-measure { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #7f8ca4; } .ds-measure i { display: block; width: 24px; height: 1px; background: rgb(150 172 214 / 0.26); } .ds-badge { font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; background: #0a6cff; border-radius: 4px; padding: 4px 8px; }

Presença completa para o negócio ser encontrado e escolhido.
components.css: .ds-plan { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 36px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgb(10 108 255 / 0.6); background: #0b1220; box-shadow: 0 30px 70px -40px rgb(10 108 255 / 0.7); font-family: 'Host Grotesk Variable', 'Host Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-plan-light { position: absolute; inset: -40% -30% auto auto; width: 90%; height: 120%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgb(34 211 238 / 0.22) 40%, rgb(10 108 255 / 0.42) 55%, transparent); transform: rotate(28deg); filter: blur(40px); opacity: 0.8; pointer-events: none; } .ds-plan h3 { position: relative; margin: 0; font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.035em; color: #f2f5fa; } .ds-plan p { position: relative; margin: 12px 0 0; color: #a3aec2; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview:
A garage at night with one cold blue light on. The page is near-black (night), and the only light source is a diagonal beam that falls from the top right in a blur of signal blue and cold cyan. Everything the beam touches reads as prepared: graphite surfaces with 1px edges, hairline rulers with tick marks, tabular numbers for durations. The mood is the team the evening before a competition, calm and ready, not a stage show.

Hierarchy is made by scale alone. Headings are a large grotesque at medium weight with tight negative tracking; there is no label above a section title, and color is never what makes something important. A single ruler stitches the page together: every section opens on it, and a short lit segment on that ruler marks how far down the page the visitor is. The brand drop sits in the scene as a lit object, rim-lit from the beam's side and cut at the base by the ruler.

The light theme is the same garage by day: cool light gray, white surfaces, navy-tinted hairlines, the same ruler and the same beam at lower intensity. Motion is one-time and slow: the light switches on once at entry, content rises a short distance on scroll, nothing loops.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black field, one diagonal blue-to-cyan beam as the only light
Hierarchy by type scale, medium weight, negative tracking; no kickers
Hairline ruler with 12px ticks and 96px major ticks opening every section
Mono uppercase reserved for measurements (durations, captions, small fixed labels)
Small-radius rectangles; primary actions carry an arrow in a square
Light theme mirrors the dark one token-for-token

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: There is one light source per scene: the diagonal beam (rotated about 22 to 28 degrees, heavily blurred, masked out toward the bottom). Glows elsewhere (primary button, lit ruler segment, first step dot, recommended plan) are that light landing on an object, always blue, never a second color.

rules.name: The Role Mirror Rule
rules.body: Every color is consumed through a theme role (bg, surface, line, heading, body, muted, accent-text, tick, beam). A new surface that hardcodes a dark-only value breaks the day garage.

rules.name: The Scale-Only Rule
rules.body: Importance is shown by size, not by color or weight. All headings are weight 500 in heading color; the step from body to headline is a jump of three to five times.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Mono uppercase is a measuring instrument: durations, ticks, captions, fixed labels. It never sits above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The Lit-Not-Lifted Rule
rules.body: Nothing rises on hover with a heavier shadow or a translate. A surface becomes important by being lit (blue border, beam inside, blue glow), not by floating.

dos: Do open every section with the ruler, and place the lit segment by the section's position on the page.
Do build hierarchy with the display and headline scales at weight 500 and negative tracking, and let headings break short (12 to 16ch).
Do use Geist Mono uppercase with tabular numerals for durations, captions and fixed measurement labels.
Do keep a single diagonal beam per scene, and show importance by lighting a surface (blue border, inner beam, blue glow).
Do use the arrow-in-a-square on primary and conversion actions, and justify label and square apart in full-width buttons.
Do consume colors through theme roles so the day garage stays a faithful mirror, with AA contrast in both themes.
Do keep motion one-time: light on at entry, short reveals, nothing looping, all of it off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't put a mono or uppercase label above a section or card title as a kicker; section headings have no label above them.
Don't add a second light color, a neon glow in another hue, or a gradient that is not the blue-to-cyan beam.
Don't lift cards on hover with translate or heavier gray shadows.
Don't round controls past 6px or cards past 10px, and don't introduce pill buttons; circles are only for the floating WhatsApp button and avatars.
Don't use typed glyph arrows (such as ← → ↗) as icons; use the inline SVG icon set.
Don't use cold-cyan as text or as a fill outside light effects.
